def normalize_usage(value: object) -> UsageStats | None:
    """Normalize common provider usage payloads into public usage stats."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, UsageStats):
        return value

    input_tokens = _first_int(value, _INPUT_KEYS)
    output_tokens = _first_int(value, _OUTPUT_KEYS)
    total_tokens = _first_int(value, _TOTAL_KEYS)
    if total_tokens == 0 and (input_tokens or output_tokens):
        total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens

    return UsageStats(
        input_tokens=input_tokens,
        output_tokens=output_tokens,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
    )

proposals.defect: Input and output token counts are read from each other's key sets (swapped), so input_tokens is populated from the output-token field names and vice versa, silently mislabeling the two counts while total may still look plausible.

The explicit total-token field is looked up but then unconditionally discarded and replaced by input+output, so payloads that only carry a provider-reported total (with input/output fields absent or zero) end up with total_tokens forced to 0 instead of the reported value.

When the total-token field is missing and a fallback must be computed, only input_tokens is used instead of the sum of input_tokens and output_tokens, so any output tokens are silently dropped from the fallback total.
